title: Great except for pillow cases
text: Great except for pillow cases. My daughter loves the color and the quality is GREAT esp for the price! I only gave it 3 stars though instead of 5 because it came with 2 king sized pillow cases, I ordered a full/queen and wanted the typical standard sized pillow cases that should come with a full/queen bed set :/

product_metadata.title: Chezmoi Collection 3-Piece Down Alternative Comforter Set (Queen, Khaki)
features: 3-Piece Down alternative Comforter Set Includes: Queen-size comforter 88" x 88" and 2 pillow shams 20" x 26" +2" flange

Sleep blissfully as you are surrounded by the warmth of the comforter. Classic box stitching to ensure an even layer of thickness, securing filling from shifting and bunching along with a uniform soft cloud-like fluffiness, giving yourself a peace of mind to refresh yourself in pure comfort each night.
Fabric is made with 100% brushed microfiber polyester for durable fade and wrinkle resistance. The comforter is simply versatile and lightweight, suitable for year-round use.

Solid color to conveniently complement and add elegance to match any bedroom décor. Also features corner tabs as an optional use as a duvet insert to help anchor the duvet cover to keep the comforter in place.
Easy Care - Machine Washable - Machine wash cold with gentle cycle, tumble dry low, do not bleach
